<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

For every target recipe, pool and routing support: route completes with an empty residual pool exactly when the pool is a permutation of the recipe and the recipe is no longer than the support, the remaining support then being the support less the recipe's length; the actual routeTrace keeps placed and residual material for every input, and route is its projection. The specified eight-slot recipe under eight support units is an instance: whole-pool completion requires exactly four A and four B.

Canonical source: [MaterialMaturation.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/universal-ethics/MaterialMaturation.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>

- Supplied target recipe and type-sensitive removal/movement; completion requires no residual pool, while failure retains partial state.

Copying a word token by token from a pool leaves the pool empty exactly where the pool holds each token exactly as often as the word uses it and the free support covers the draws of the attachments (empties_iff; countOf_removeAll: after removal each token’s count is its count less the word’s).
